alternate_carrier_audit.scope: no stronger automatic proof among the ten frozen two-sandwich stars; not a no-go for other carrier types
alternate_carrier_audit.why_not_stronger: its Q contains fixed A45=I, hence Q is full and it does not exclude any e_i already in P=Col(A06)

exact_reduction.independence: A06*v=0 and alpha nonzero imply w and v are linearly independent
exact_reduction.minor_cover: because v_q nonzero, at least one d(q,t)=w_q*v_t-w_t*v_q for t!=q is nonzero
exact_reduction.parameterization: choose d=d(a,b), set alpha=d*abar and the remaining A06 column c=d*t; Cramer formulas solve the other two A06 columns polynomially
exact_reduction.reverse: divide alpha by d and recover the original witness x=w/(d*abar); all nine A06 entries satisfy the original incidence and guard-row-p equations
